# humanizer

> humanizer is a 12B text-completion model (fine-tuned from google/gemma-4-12B, Apache 2.0) that rewrites one AI-written draft, in English or Chinese, so it reads like a person wrote it. It is trained to keep every number, unit, date, name and quote and to add nothing. It is NOT a chat model: send a raw completion prompt. (The GGUF files uploaded on or after 2026-10-04 carry a chat template that builds the same prompt from the last user message, so chat front ends that use it should work; in code, use the completion endpoint.)

Weights: https://huggingface.co/jialinyyzz/humanizer. Pick by memory: 32 GB or more → humanizer-12b-Q8_0.gguf (12,669,630,304 bytes); 16 GB → humanizer-12b-Q6_K.gguf (10,029,799,520 bytes), or humanizer-12b-Q4_K_M.gguf (7,625,160,800 bytes) if memory or disk is tight; 8 GB → lite/humanizer-lite-Q6_K.gguf (earlier E4B release, about 6.2 GB, same prompt). Always also download prompt_format.json. bf16 model.safetensors (about 24 GB) is at the repo root for transformers, vLLM and MLX. Desktop app for macOS (Apple silicon) and Windows: https://github.com/sgaofen/humanize-model/releases/latest

Minimal recipe:

1. Install llama.cpp (brew install llama.cpp / winget install llama.cpp / https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases).
2. hf download jialinyyzz/humanizer humanizer-12b-Q8_0.gguf prompt_format.json --local-dir ./humanizer-model
3. llama-server -m ./humanizer-model/humanizer-12b-Q8_0.gguf -c 8192 -np 1 -ngl 99 --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080
4. prompt = instr + "\n\n" + draft.strip() + "\n\n### Rewritten:\n\n"   (instr and sep are in prompt_format.json; check: sha256(prompt for draft "X")[:16] == "cc51d66b4c593fbe")
5. POST http://127.0.0.1:8080/completion with {"prompt": prompt, "temperature": 1.0, "top_p": 0.95, "top_k": 0, "min_p": 0, "repeat_penalty": 1.0, "n_predict": 2048}. No stop strings; it ends at EOS. The rewrite is in "content".

The instruction text (instr), verbatim, lines joined with "\n", no trailing newline:

    Rewrite the text below so it reads like a person wrote it, not a language model.

    Reorganize it as you see fit. Vary sentence length on purpose. Cut hedging,
    throat-clearing, and any sentence that only announces what comes next.
    Prefer the concrete word over the abstract one. It is fine to sound uneven.

    Every fact, number, unit, date, name and quotation must survive unchanged.

Long or structured documents (Markdown, .docx): use the hz command instead of raw requests. pipx install git+https://github.com/sgaofen/humanize-model (python-docx for .docx: pipx inject humanize-model python-docx), then hz input.md -o output.md --json. It uses the running Humanizer app or a llama-server (--server URL, default http://127.0.0.1:8080), keeps headings, code, tables and links, rewrites prose in pieces of about 350 words, flags missing or added numbers and copying, and retries a bad piece once. Exit code 3 = no model running.

Rules: one draft per request; use the completion endpoint, not a chat endpoint or a generic chat template; don't reword the instruction; ask the user to proofread numbers, dates and names (on the evaluation set a strict judge found no factual problem in 376 of 420 English rewrites, and more than 9 in 10 of the fixes it listed are a single word or phrase); never promise that output passes an AI detector.

## Docs

- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/sgaofen/humanize-model/blob/main/AGENTS.md): step-by-step install, exact prompt, API call, self-test script, troubleshooting
- [docs/USAGE.md, section 14](https://github.com/sgaofen/humanize-model/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md#14-hz-command-line-tool): the hz command-line tool: install, how documents are split, checks, --json fields
- [docs/USAGE.md](https://github.com/sgaofen/humanize-model/blob/main/docs/USAGE.md): usage without the app: llama.cpp, MLX, transformers, vLLM, Ollama, LM Studio, batch script for a folder, long documents, Chinese ([中文](https://github.com/sgaofen/humanize-model/blob/main/docs/USAGE.zh.md))
- [README.md](https://github.com/sgaofen/humanize-model/blob/main/README.md): overview, evaluation results, usage for llama.cpp, MLX, transformers, Ollama and LM Studio
- [docs/INSTALL.md](https://github.com/sgaofen/humanize-model/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.md): install guide for people (app and command line, macOS, Windows, Linux, FAQ)

## Files

- [prompt_format.json](https://huggingface.co/jialinyyzz/humanizer/resolve/main/prompt_format.json): instruction and separator, verbatim
- [humanizer-12b-Q8_0.gguf](https://huggingface.co/jialinyyzz/humanizer/resolve/main/humanizer-12b-Q8_0.gguf): recommended GGUF (32 GB or more)
- [humanizer-12b-Q6_K.gguf](https://huggingface.co/jialinyyzz/humanizer/resolve/main/humanizer-12b-Q6_K.gguf): GGUF for 16 GB machines
- [humanizer-12b-Q4_K_M.gguf](https://huggingface.co/jialinyyzz/humanizer/resolve/main/humanizer-12b-Q4_K_M.gguf): smallest 12B GGUF, when memory or disk is tight
- [humanizer/promptfmt.py](https://github.com/sgaofen/humanize-model/blob/main/humanizer/promptfmt.py): reference prompt builder
